env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^8 8 -2 2$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/propselector

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type Slotted interface {
	Item int
}

type Slot struct : Slotted {
	Item int
}

type Counter struct : Slotted {
	last int
	sets int
}

func (c *Counter) Item() int {
	return c.last
}

func (c *Counter) SetItem(v int) {
	c.last = v
	c.sets++
}

func main() {
	var s Slotted = &Slot{}
	s /* a */ . /* b */ Item = 5
	s. /* c */ Item += 2
	s . Item++
	c := &Counter{}
	var m Slotted = c
	m /* d */ . /* e */ Item = 1
	m /* f */ . /* g */ Item -= 3
	fmt.Println(s.Item, /* h */ s /* i */ . /* j */ Item, m.Item, c.sets)
}
